records.label: spacr.figures.style.ensure_identity_contrast#1
records.source: Only supplied Line2D hulls and PathCollection points are eligible, and only colors in the supplied identity bindings can receive a border. Each draw checks its actual composited contrast and alpha, including mixed arrays; invisible paths stay invisible. The hollow backing never fills a marker face twice. Artist colors, alpha, sizes, widths, paths and offsets remain exact. Existing manual path effects are left untouched. The thin additional border can affect boundary antialiasing and requires actual visual review.
records.context: Only supplied Line2D hulls and PathCollection points are eligible, and only colors in the supplied identity bindings can receive a border. Each draw checks its actual composited contrast and alpha, including mixed arrays; invisible paths stay invisible. The hollow backing never fills a marker face twice. Artist colors, alpha, sizes, widths, paths and offsets remain exact. Existing manual path effects are left untouched. The thin additional border can affect boundary antialiasing and requires actual visual review.
records.translation: Solo son elegibles las envolventes Line2D y los puntos PathCollection proporcionados, y solo los colores de las asociaciones de identidad suministradas pueden recibir un borde. Cada dibujo comprueba el contraste real tras la composición y el alfa, incluidas las matrices mixtas; los trazados invisibles permanecen invisibles. El respaldo hueco nunca rellena dos veces el interior de un marcador. Los colores, el alfa, los tamaños, los grosores, los trazados y los desplazamientos de los objetos gráficos permanecen exactos. Los efectos manuales de trazado existentes no se modifican. El borde fino adicional puede afectar al suavizado de los límites y requiere una revisión visual real.
records.review_basis: Codex (OpenAI) AI translation and review on 2026-11-23 of Measure and quality-control graph captions and API documentation. No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.source: 3-channel ``(H, W, 3)`` image already scaled to ``[0, 1]``. It is added to the colormap rather than blended, so a ``[0, 255]`` image swamps the heatmap and the result is a near-uniform wash. A 2-D grayscale array fails to broadcast against the 3-channel heatmap. An image negative enough that the blend has no positive pixel left raises ``ValueError`` rather than returning a black frame, because a black attribution map cannot be distinguished from a map with no attribution.

records.label: spacr.utils.show_cam_on_image#4
records.source: ``(H, W)`` activation map in ``[0, 1]``, matching ``img`` in height and width. Values outside that range are CLIPPED to it, with a :class:`RuntimeWarning`, so an un-normalized CAM saturates at the hot end instead of wrapping in the ``np.uint8`` cast; unclipped, ``1.1`` would land at the cold end of jet, ``1.5`` in the middle and ``2.0`` back at the top. An all-zero mask does not produce a black overlay: jet maps 0 to a non-zero color, so a zero mask over a zero image renormalizes to a saturated flat field.

Una máscara toda a cero no produce una superposición negra: jet asigna a 0 un color distinto de cero, así que una máscara cero sobre una imagen cero se renormaliza a un campo plano saturado.
